svg.title: Why a 13.5 nm mirror is a Bragg stack
svg.desc: Animated cross-section of eight Mo/Si bilayers with one reflected ray each, the eight reflections summed as rotating phasors that line up at the Bragg peak, and the computed reflectance against wavelength near 13.5 nm and against incidence angle for s and p polarization.
